s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with a palpable mass and ovarian tumor
salient_findings: Markedly distended abdomen with a palpable mass
Ovarian tumor with a diameter of 18 cm
Large, fluid-filled lesion in the pelvis and mid-abdomen
key_facts: 17-year-old nulliparous female
Two-year history of gradually progressive abdominal distension
Initial presentation with bloating
Denial of pain, vaginal bleeding, or systemic symptoms
No personal or family history of cancer
BMI 20.5 kg/m2
Blood pressure 125/85 mmHg
Pulse 89/min
SpO2 95% on room air
Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL with a microcytic profile
APTT, INR, electrolytes, urea, and creatinine were normal
Tumor markers HE4, LDH, alpha-fetoprotein, CA-125, and β-hCG within normal limits or slightly elevated

differentials: Ovarian small cell carcinoma of the ovary
Ovarian desmoplastic small round cell tumor
per_call: Ovarian small cell carcinoma of the ovary
Ovarian desmoplastic small round cell tumor

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large, fluid-filled ovarian tumor with a unilocular appearance and no septations or solid components

shortlist.label: Serous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large size and fluid-filled appearance, consistent with a serous cystadenoma

shortlist.label: Ovarian cystadenofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large size and fluid-filled appearance, with a possible fibromatous component

shortlist.label: Dermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large size and possible teratomatous components, although less likely given the unilocular appearance

shortlist.label: Simple ovarian cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Large, fluid-filled ovarian tumor with a unilocular appearance, although less likely given the size and patient's age

raw.rationale: The large, fluid-filled, unilocular lesion with a thin wall and no septations or solid components is suggestive of a mucinous cystadenoma, which is a type of ovarian tumor that can present with gradual abdominal distension and can be benign.

rejected.label: Serous cystadenoma
rejected.why: While possible, serous cystadenomas are less likely to present as a large, unilocular cyst

rejected.label: Ovarian cystadenofibroma
rejected.why: These tumors often have a more complex appearance with solid components

rejected.label: Dermoid cyst
rejected.why: Dermoid cysts typically contain solid components and have a more complex appearance on imaging

rejected.label: Simple ovarian cyst
rejected.why: Simple ovarian cysts are typically smaller and less likely to cause significant abdominal distension
